{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ord Mantell military database''' was a database run by the [[Republic Army]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Separatist War]] there, which was part of the greater [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

During the war it was accessible via [[Holovid/Legends|Holovid]] intelligence hubs and would list missions for Republic supporters or soldiers to complete. One of which was located in the Republic stronghold of [[Fort Garnik]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Ord Mantell military database was first mentioned in the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released in [[2011]] by [[BioWare]]. It was identified in the mission text for the quest ''unsafe safe houses'' which could be completed by players of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] or [[Trooper/Legends|Trooper]] class on their starting [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].
